reason: The README describes an external-service integration that uses a user-authorized ChatGPT/Codex OAuth session to provide Codex models, optional search, and gpt-image-2 image generation and editing within DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 通过用户授权的 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 会话，在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 Codex 模型、可选搜索以及 gpt-image-2 图像生成和编辑功能。
summaries.en: Uses a user-authorized ChatGPT/Codex OAuth session to provide Codex models, optional search, and gpt-image-2 image generation and editing in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: ChatGPT/Codex OAuth sign-in and token refresh through the host credential store
Access to Codex models through an external provider
Image generation and editing through gpt-image-2
Read local image references and write generated image files and attachments
